variants.prompt: On the opulent deck of a luxurious yacht, a bohemian beauty struts confidently in a skintight leather bodysuit that hugs her curves like a second skin, the shiny black material contrasting with her fiery auburn locks and porcelain skin. She wears a wide-brimmed floppy hat, layered necklaces, and strappy heels, exuding a daring, provocative allure as the setting sun casts a warm, golden light that accentuates her every move. With a bold, commanding gaze and a subtle smirk, she seems to own the world as the DSLR camera captures her in a shallow focus wide shot, the blurred background only emphasizing her striking figure.
